high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "thedekorcompany." The post features a decorative ceramic vase with a rustic charm design. The vase is small and has a geometric pattern with triangular shapes etched into its surface, giving it a textured appearance. The color scheme includes shades of blue and gold, with the top part of the vase having a golden, ornate finial. The background of the image shows a marble surface, which adds to the overall aesthetic appeal of the product. The vase is placed centrally against a dark backdrop, making it stand out prominently.
